name: APC Minimal
description: The APC Minimal WebView design library, aligned to the canonical visual source hub/_design/apc_filter_f30_annotate_v006.html: deep teal plates, raised blue-green surfaces, a coral signal accent, cyan status and spectrum colour, compact rounded corners, subtle material depth, and mono numerals. It is a complete starting point; copy the folder to make a new design.

referenceSource.serving: The Hub serves the source HTML byte for byte; optional token previews and saved element tuning are applied at runtime only.

_note: The canonical visual reference is hub/_design/apc_filter_f30_annotate_v006.html and is served byte for byte by the Hub. tokens.css is the global token contract for APC UI kit components; this file documents the same token values (tokens.night / tokens.day), intent, WCAG ratios, element spec and elementTuning overrides saved through APC Hub 09C. scripts/design-tokens-check.js and test/design-tokens.test.js fail when the token documents drift, an element references a token that does not exist, or a registered kit element has no entry. Change global values in tokens.css first; use 09C Element Spec for validated per-element geometry and line tuning.
philosophy: One coral signal on a deep teal instrument surface, with cyan for healthy activity and multi-hue data series for analysis. Information comes from shape, position, type and colour together.
principles: A deep teal plate and graduated blue-green control surfaces establish layers; small restrained shadows and knob gradients add material depth without hiding boundaries.
Compact 2-3px control and panel radii soften the instrument surfaces while keeping a precise grid.
Hairline rules define most boundaries; stronger control borders and focus rings stay visible against both plate modes.
Coral (--accent) marks active signal and focus. Cyan (--ok) marks healthy activity; separate accessible series colours distinguish visualisation data.
Uppercase, letter-spaced labels pair with tabular mono numerals. Longer sentences use the text sans.
High contrast and accessible: text pairs >= 4.5:1, graphics and control boundaries >= 3:1 in both modes; visualisation series also differ by dash pattern.
Motion off by default; any transition must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

shape.note: APC Minimal uses compact 2-3px radii and restrained popup/control shadows. Popups are separated by a --rule border plus the --apc-overlay scrim. --r-radio and --r-led use compact square-mark values unless a design sets them independently.

spacing.unit: rem (one grid cell; the kit scales as a whole)

motion.note: No transitions or animation by default. Anything that moves (meter ballistics, playhead) is functional, not decorative, and must stop or become static under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

dataviz.note: Series and modulation colours follow the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe set; day mode uses darker variants so they stay >= 3:1 on --inset. Series must also differ by dash pattern / marker, never by colour alone.

knob.title: Knob
knob.summary: Rotary parameter control: vertical drag. A quiet 270 deg track (open 90 deg at the bottom), one accent value arc, a gradient disc with a soft shadow and a rim pointer; name above the dial, value below.

track.sweep: 270 deg, 90 deg gap at the bottom

a11y.keys: Arrows nudge (Shift fine, PageUp/PageDown coarse), Home/End min/max, Enter opens value entry, Alt+click or double-click resets

slider.title: Slider
slider.summary: Linear parameter control (vertical or horizontal). A 2px quiet rail with an accent fill and a thin tall cap; name above the value.

a11y.keys: Arrows nudge (Shift fine, PageUp/PageDown coarse), Home/End min/max, Enter opens value entry, Alt+click or double-click resets

button.title: Button
button.summary: Flat chip on the raised control body. Active and chosen states invert to ink; there is no filled signal button in this language.

a11y.keys: Enter / Space; latch variant exposes aria-pressed; with data-param Enter/Space press on keydown and release on keyup

buttons.title: Button group
buttons.summary: One choice of N shown as a joined row (or column) of buttons; binds to a choice or stepped parameter.

a11y.keys: Roving tabindex; arrows move and select (wrap), Home/End, Space/Enter select the focused one

segmented.title: Segmented
segmented.summary: One body of chips split by hairlines; the chosen chip inverts to ink. Never a row of separate buttons.

a11y.keys: Roving tabindex; arrows move and select (wrap), Home/End, Space/Enter select the focused one

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.summary: Miniature switch: a 2px-radius track with a square cam. Off = raised body with an ink cam; on = the whole track fills with the signal colour and the cam goes dark.

a11y.keys: Space / Enter toggle; arrows set on/off

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.summary: Boolean with a 1.2-cell square mark (2px radius). Checked = accent edge plus an accent inset square; mixed = one ink hairline across.

a11y.keys: Space toggles (click on box or label); aria-checked true | false | mixed

radio.title: Radio group
radio.summary: One choice from a set. Same square mark as the checkbox (the plate uses one mark language); selected = accent edge plus an accent inset square.

a11y.keys: Roving tabindex; arrows move and select (wrap), Home/End

selector.title: Selector
selector.summary: A raised field with a structural edge; the value is mono, the arrows are quiet and only wash on hover.

a11y.keys: ArrowUp/ArrowRight next, ArrowDown/ArrowLeft previous, Home/End first/last, Enter or click opens the menu, Alt+click resets

dropdown.title: Dropdown
dropdown.summary: Closed field that opens a popup listbox (optionally searchable); binds to a choice or stepped parameter.

a11y.keys: Closed: Down/Up/Enter/Space/Alt+Down open, typing jumps. Open: arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End, Enter chooses, Esc closes, Tab leaves

menu.title: Menu
menu.summary: Popup, anchor or context menu with checkable items, shortcuts, separators and one submenu level.

a11y.keys: Arrows (wrap), Home/End, Right opens a submenu, Left/Esc closes it, Enter/Space use, Tab closes, typing jumps

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.summary: No box: a structural rule under the row and a 2px accent rule under the chosen tab.

a11y.keys: Roving tabindex; Left/Right (Up/Down vertical) move and activate, wrap, skip disabled; Home/End

list.title: List
list.summary: No box, no radius: flat rows on the wash. The chosen row sits on the raised body and carries a 2px accent rule on its leading edge.

a11y.keys: One tab stop (aria-activedescendant); arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, type-ahead; multi: Space toggles, Shift+arrow extends, Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all

textfield.title: Text field
textfield.summary: Single-line text input with validation, help text and an error message under the field.

a11y.keys: Enter commits (invalid stays focused with the message), Esc restores the last committed value

numberfield.title: Number field
numberfield.summary: Typed numeric input with units and step buttons; parsing and formatting are shared with the knob value entry.

a11y.keys: Enter commits, Esc reverts, Up/Down step (Shift fine), PageUp/PageDown coarse, wheel while focused; step buttons repeat on hold

label.title: Label
label.summary: Static text in one of four roles: title, label, caption (sentence) or value.

a11y.keys: Not focusable; data-for names another widget via aria-labelledby

readout.title: Readout
readout.summary: Live read-only value (a parameter or a meter feed) with an optional caption.

a11y.keys: Not focusable; no announcements while values stream

panel.title: Panel
panel.summary: Titled frame with a hairline border and an optional collapsible header.

a11y.keys: Header is a native button (Enter/Space) with aria-expanded when collapsible

divider.title: Divider
divider.summary: Hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, with optional inline text.

a11y.keys: Not focusable; aria-orientation set

led.title: LED
led.summary: A square lamp with no ring. On is the energy cyan; a gate is the accent; clip is the limit red with a halo.

a11y.keys: Not focusable

progress.title: Progress
progress.summary: A well with a hairline inset edge and a 1px radius; the fill is the accent. Not a rounded pill.

a11y.keys: Not focusable; aria-valuenow/min/max/valuetext (no valuenow while indeterminate)

logo.title: Logo
logo.summary: Wordmark or lockup slot (text, image or inline SVG); a link only when a URL is configured.

a11y.keys: The button exists only when a URL is configured; Enter/Space open it through apc.openUrl

graph.title: Graph
graph.summary: Frequency response: a faint cyan grid, one accent curve with a dark fill, and band nodes drawn as a ring with a centred dot.

a11y.role: img (no nodes) | group (with nodes); each node role=slider
a11y.keys: Arrows move the node (Shift fine, PageUp/PageDown coarse), + / - change Q, Delete resets, Alt+click resets; text alternative via aria-describedby

envelope.title: Envelope
envelope.summary: ADSR curve in the accent over a dark fill, with one ring-dot handle per breakpoint and a hairline grid.

a11y.role: group; each node role=slider (Attack, Decay and sustain, Release)
a11y.keys: Arrows move the node, Insert adds a point after it (multi), Delete removes a free point, Alt+click resets

spectrum.title: Spectrum
spectrum.summary: Bar spectrum: thin energy-cyan bars on a faint grid, with white peak-hold ticks. Energy is cyan; red belongs to the limit, not the spectrum.

a11y.keys: Display only; text alternative names the strongest component (updated at most once per second)

waveform.title: Waveform
waveform.summary: Sample waveform display: static peaks, a scrolling roll, or an oscilloscope trace.

a11y.keys: Display only; text alternative states the value range

scope.title: Scope
scope.summary: Oscilloscope trace with an optional rising-zero-crossing trigger (the waveform element in scope mode).

a11y.keys: Display only; text alternative states the value range

meter.title: Meter
meter.summary: Level meter (1 or 2 channels, continuous or segmented) with peak hold, a latching clip lamp and warn/clip zones.

a11y.keys: The clip lamp is a real button: click, Enter or Space resets the latch

stepseq.title: Step sequencer
stepseq.summary: Step grid (gate, value or pitch mode) with accents, beat grouping and a playhead; paint with the pointer or edit by keyboard.

a11y.keys: Arrows move (value/pitch: Up/Down edit), Home/End, Space/Enter toggle, Shift+Space accent, Delete clears

xypad.title: XY pad
xypad.summary: Two-axis pad bound to two parameters: absolute press-and-drag, Shift for relative fine control.

a11y.keys: Arrows move 1 % (Shift 0.1 %), PageUp/PageDown y 10 %, Home/End x min/max, Delete resets, Alt+click or double-click resets

picture.title: Picture
picture.summary: Image or artwork slot (relative path or data URI only, never the network) with a token-coloured placeholder and an optional spectrum overlay.

a11y.role: img (aria-label = alt; role=presentation when alt is empty)
a11y.keys: Display only; a rejected or broken URL shows a visible error block (role=alert)

header.title: Header
header.summary: Brand lockup (logo and name link only when a URL is configured), save slot, help button, theme switch, scale control and settings gear.

a11y.keys: Brand links are buttons (Enter/Space) with aria-label "Open ... website"

footer.title: Footer
footer.summary: Version always visible, licence badge (demo / trial / licensed / unverified), update note and a preset status slot.

a11y.role: from the host element (<footer> = contentinfo); preset slot role=status
a11y.keys: Badge and update note are buttons (Enter/Space)

scale.title: Scale control
scale.summary: Smaller / larger buttons with the current interface scale (50..300 % in steps of 25 %).

a11y.keys: Enter/Space on the buttons; the value is an aria-live output

gripper.title: Gripper
gripper.summary: Corner resize handle (drag or arrow keys, aspect-locked, snaps to 5 %) with a live percentage badge.

a11y.keys: Arrows +/- 5 %, PageUp/PageDown +/- 25 %

theme-switch.title: Theme switch
theme-switch.summary: Button that cycles night, day and auto; hidden until the host enables theming.

a11y.keys: Enter / Space

help-button.title: Help button
help-button.summary: Visible button that toggles help mode (F1 or ? are only accelerators); a pressed state shows the mode is on.

a11y.keys: Enter / Space; F1 or ? as accelerators

infobar.title: Info bar
infobar.summary: One-line status text: idle hint, hovered control description or the active help mode.

a11y.keys: Not focusable

preset-chip.title: Preset chip
preset-chip.summary: Compact preset control: name with dirty marker, previous/next, browse and save buttons.

a11y.keys: Buttons: Enter / Space; Browse opens the preset browser

context-panel.title: Context panel
context-panel.summary: Right-click panel of a control: VALUE, MODULATION, MIDI and HELP sections (not a data-apc element; opened by the controls).

slider-fill.origin: 0 of a zero-centred range, else the minimum

a11y.keys: Esc closes; opened by right-click, the more button or Shift+F10; the modulation amount slider is a native range input (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End)

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.summary: Parameter tooltip with title, live value, up to three lines of help and key hints (not a data-apc element; fixed anchor, never under the pointer); the title="" attribute of any kit control is shown here too (the OS bubble is suppressed while hovering).

a11y.keys: Shown on hover and keyboard focus after ui.tooltip_delay_ms; never while dragging

toast.title: Toast
toast.summary: Dismissible notification (info, warn, error) used for every never-fail-silently report; stacked bottom right (not a data-apc element).

a11y.keys: The close button is focusable; Enter/Space dismiss

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: Trigger (gear) that opens the settings overlay: Global, Engine/Quality, MIDI, Presets & Data, License and About tabs.

select.caret: OS caret drawn in --ink (appearance menulist-button); option list --ink on --inset

a11y.keys: Esc closes; Tab cycles inside; arrows move between tabs

license.title: License
license.summary: Activation dialog: status badge, serial or key-file entry, offline request, deactivate.

a11y.keys: Esc closes; drop target for key files; errors are role=alert

update.title: Update
update.summary: Update dialog: check, download progress bar, release notes and the ready-to-install instruction.

a11y.keys: Esc closes; errors are role=alert

presets.title: Preset browser
presets.summary: Preset browser: scopes, search, filters, sort, a virtualised list with ratings and favorites, A/B, save and revert.

sizes.default: min(40rem, 96vw); wide variant min(46rem, 96vw) x min(25rem, 92vh)

a11y.role: listbox (presets) in a modal dialog; scopes role=radiogroup
a11y.keys: Arrows/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End in the list, Enter loads, Esc closes

elementsSchema.note: elements[<data-apc name>] = { title, group (one of groups), summary, parts, states, sizes, options, a11y }. Every value is a token name, a compound of tokens and literals or a plain literal. The values document the kit CSS and canvas drawing. APC Hub 09C exposes only validated, supported geometry and stroke controls for each element; colour is edited globally through tokens.css.
elementsSchema.parts: parts[<part>][<property label>] = value in the default state. The part "host" carries the focus outline and opacity.
elementsSchema.states: states[<state>]["<part>.<property label>"] = value that REPLACES the default while that state applies. State names: default, hover, active, focus, disabled, selected, error, checked, open (only states that exist for the element are listed; "default" is the parts themselves). hover/active/focus/disabled are interaction states, selected/checked/open/error are value states.
elementsSchema.sizes: sizes.default = token or literal; sizes.overridable = per-control overrides (data-* attributes and CSS custom properties such as --w-h or --slider-len that are NOT design tokens).
elementsSchema.pseudo: context-panel, tooltip and toast are not data-apc elements (opened by the kit); they are listed so a design can restyle them.

fontsets.note: Documented alternatives for --font-ui (labels, values, buttons) and --font-text (sentences). System-safe stacks only: a WebView plugin must never load a network font (no @import, no Google Fonts, no CDN). Every stack ends in a generic family, so a missing face degrades instead of breaking layout. Values and labels keep font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so prefer faces with tabular digits for --font-ui.

ui.label: Mono (default)
ui.note: Consolas on Windows, Menlo on macOS, DejaVu Sans Mono on Linux. The default APC Minimal look.

ui.label: Mono classic
ui.note: Available everywhere; thinner strokes, a typewriter feel.

ui.label: System sans
ui.note: Same as --font-text; labels stay uppercase and letter-spaced.

ui.label: Humanist sans
ui.note: Friendly, open apertures; good at small sizes.

ui.label: Condensed sans
ui.note: Saves width in dense panels; falls back to Arial where the condensed face is missing.

ui.label: Rounded
ui.value: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
ui.note: Rounded terminals on Apple systems; ordinary sans elsewhere.

text.label: System sans (default)
text.note: The default for help, notes and dialogs.

text.label: Serif
text.note: For manuals and long notes; keep --font-ui as it is for controls.

text.label: Mono
text.value: Consolas, "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", ui-monospace, monospace
text.note: Everything in mono, for a terminal feel.

scales.note: Each --t-* token is max(<px floor>, <rem>). rem makes text scale with the plugin (1 rem = one grid cell, the whole UI scales with the window and the 50..300 % scale control); the px floor stops it shrinking below legible size when the UI is scaled down. Above the floor the ratios between steps are constant, below it the steps compress, so keep the ladder strictly increasing in the rem part.
rules: Never set a text size below the floors: 9px for micro text, 10px for labels, 11px for values and readouts, 12px for titles, 14px for headings.
A design may change a rem part or a floor, but must keep the order --t-micro <= --t-label <= --t-value <= --t-readout <= --t-title <= --t-head in both the rem part and the floor.
Use px floors for legibility only; do not use px for layout (the kit sizes everything in rem so it scales as a whole).
--label-spacing is in em, so letter-spacing follows the font size of each label.

tokens.use: smallest text: footers, tick labels, node numbers
numeric values, field text, menu items

descriptions.--apc-letterbox: Window letterbox outside the plate. Always black.
descriptions.--plate: Plugin background; the reference for every text pair.
descriptions.--plate-2: Raised panel and control body (raised by colour only, never by shadow).
descriptions.--plate-3: Raised CONTROL body, one step above --plate-2: buttons, fields, segment tracks, flip caps.
descriptions.--wash: Hover wash over a control body: a 6% ink veil, never a filled hover colour.
descriptions.--knob: The machined face: the gradient end colour of a dial.

descriptions.--rule: Control borders and dividers that must be seen (>= 3:1, WCAG 1.4.11).
descriptions.--rule-2: Quiet dividers and grid lines; decorative, carries no information.

descriptions.--ink-2: Labels, units and secondary text (>= 4.5:1 on plate, plate-2, inset).
descriptions.--ink-3: Micro labels, units and axis ticks: the quietest ink.

descriptions.--accent: THE signal colour: active, selected, value arc, focus. Fills, rings and lines.
descriptions.--accent-ink: Text and icons drawn on an --accent fill.
descriptions.--accent-text: Accent-coloured TEXT (tooltip value, badge, link, mode label); >= 4.5:1 on the surfaces.
descriptions.--ok-text: Success TEXT (badges, messages); >= 4.5:1 on the surfaces.
descriptions.--apc-danger-text: Error / destructive TEXT (labels, messages, badges); >= 4.5:1 on the surfaces.
descriptions.--apc-focus: Keyboard focus ring colour (follows --accent by default).
descriptions.--apc-overlay: Scrim behind modal sheets and dialogs.
descriptions.--memory: Memory / modulated value: the warm hue that never means danger.

descriptions.--viz-line: Primary curve, waveform and spectrum line.
descriptions.--viz-accent: Highlighted curve, nodes, spectrum bars, xypad thumb.
descriptions.--viz-axis: Axis labels, ticks and small plot text.
descriptions.--viz-1: Data series 1 (colour-blind-safe; series also differ by dash pattern).

descriptions.--meter-ok: Meter zone below the warn level.
descriptions.--meter-warn: Meter zone between warn and clip; warn LED and progress bar.
descriptions.--meter-clip: Meter zone at or above clip and the latched clip lamp.
descriptions.--led-off: LED lamp and unlit meter segments when off.

descriptions.--apc-mod-1: Modulation source 1 (Okabe-Ito; also a dash pattern).

descriptions.--r-panel: Corner radius of panels, popups and sheets.
descriptions.--r-radio: Corner radius of the radio box (50% = round); follows --r-control.
descriptions.--r-led: Corner radius of LED lamps (50% = round); follows --r-control.
descriptions.--r-well: Well corner radius (dialogs, fields, graph wells).

descriptions.--sh-recess: Shadow of recessed wells. none in a flat design; any box-shadow otherwise.
descriptions.--sh-raised: Shadow of raised controls. none in a flat design.
descriptions.--apc-shadow-pop: Shadow of popups, menus, tooltips, toasts. none: they are separated by a --rule border and the scrim.
descriptions.--sh-knob: Dial and thumb shadow, with an inner top highlight built in.
descriptions.--halo: Glow behind a live or clip state (dial active, LED on).

descriptions.--font-ui: Labels, values, buttons and every non-sentence text. See fontsets.ui.
descriptions.--font-text: Sentences: help, notes, dialog body, messages. See fontsets.text.
descriptions.--font-num: The numeric family: JetBrains Mono, tabular numerals.

descriptions.--t-value: Numeric value and field text size (floor 11px).

descriptions.--ctl-h: Height of buttons, fields, dropdowns, tabs (1 rem = one grid cell).
descriptions.--knob-size: Default knob diameter (per control: data-size or --knob-size).
descriptions.--track-w: Slider, meter and progress track thickness.
descriptions.--apc-viz-node: Graph/envelope node and xypad thumb size.

elementTuningSchema.note: Saved per-element overrides from APC Hub 09C use elementTuning[<data-apc name>][<property>]. The Hub validates each property and range against its supported tuning controls. Values equal to the kit defaults are omitted. Global colour values remain in tokens.css.
